meta.title: Every validation message is readable and names the problem
warnings: the QA memory is not built, so the plan was written without it — run `npm run rag:build`

steps.note: Create the RFQ needed for the refusal scenarios.
Provide the required event title.
Use an RFQ so vendor pricing, surrogate bidding, and price-cap validations are available.
Apply the RFQ pricing template.
Add the line item required for pricing validations.
Complete the pricing sheet before publishing.
Commit a valid event schedule.
Add the participant required to publish and bid.
Publish the event so refusal paths on a live event can be exercised.
Confirm the event reached a published project page.
Open the invited vendor session for the invalid vendor-price refusal.
Open the event's pricing sheet in the supplier portal.
Verify the negative price is refused with a message naming the price problem.
Return to the buyer console for buyer-side refusal paths.
Open the published participants list for surrogate bidding and price-cap validation.
Verify submitting a surrogate bid without a price is refused with a price-related message.
Attempt to save a vendor price cap without entering a value; the step checks Procol's refusal.
Confirm the price-cap refusal is an error message naming the price requirement.
Verify a past submission end time is refused with a time-related message.
Attempt withdrawal without the required remark.
Confirm the withdrawal refusal names the missing remark requirement.
